name: Zákányfalu (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, orange and white in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zákányfalu: a red and white shield with a tree, a patriarchal cross and a castle on a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
